shortDescription: Save the the licensed program(product) to a save file

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: check_signature
options.description: Specifies if the digital signatures of objects being saved with the licensed program are to be checked.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the available job log even the rc is 0(success).

options.name: language
options.description: Specifies which national language version (NLV) is used for the save operation. It's the IBM-supplied language feature codes, like German is 2924, English is 2924. This parameter is ignored when object_type C(*PGM) is specified.

options.name: object_type
options.description: Specifies the type of licensed program objects being saved.

options.name: option
options.description: Specifies the optional parts of the licensed program given in the Product prompt (LICPGM parameter) that are saved.

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters that SAVLICPGM command will take. Other than options above, all other parameters need to be specified here. The default values of parameters for SAVLICPGM will be taken if not specified. Parameter CLEAR in SAVLICPGM command should not be specified here, C(CLEAR(*ALL)) already used.

options.name: product
options.description: Specifies the seven-character identifier of the licensed program that is saved.

options.name: release
options.description: Specifies which version, release, and modification level of the licensed program is saved.

options.name: savf_library
options.description: Specify the name of the library where the save file is located, if it is not existed, will create it.

options.name: savf_name
options.description: Specify the name of the save file, if it is not existed, will create it.

options.name: target_release
options.description: Specifies the release level of the operating system on which you intend to restore and use the product.
